questions.q: A petty cashier operates an imprest of ₦5,000. During a particular week, she spent ₦1,200 on stationeries, ₦800 on traveling, and ₦1,500 on postage. How much will be reimbursed to the petty cashier at the end of the week to restore the imprest float?
questions.explain:
Under the **imprest system**, the reimbursement made at the end of the period is exactly equal to the total amount disbursed (spent) during that period, in order to restore the balance back to the original float.

Total amount spent = $₦1,200 + ₦800 + ₦1,500 = ₦3,500$.
Thus, the cashier will be reimbursed **₦3,500**.
